componentMappings.title: API process host
componentMappings.rationale: Owns process startup, Fastify listen lifecycle and reconciler host/watchdog bootstrapping.

componentMappings.title: Fastify application composition
componentMappings.rationale: Builds Fastify, observability, readiness, operational/protected routes and the protected runtime module.

componentMappings.title: Application services and ports
componentMappings.rationale: Application-facing use cases, authorization/start-run boundaries and explicit ports.

componentMappings.title: API-owned domain behavior
componentMappings.rationale: Domain behavior owned by the API bounded application rather than provider adapters.

componentMappings.title: HTTP entrypoints
componentMappings.rationale: Inbound HTTP registration and request boundary code.

componentMappings.title: Infrastructure adapters
componentMappings.rationale: Concrete infrastructure implementations behind API application boundaries.

componentMappings.title: Runtime module composition
componentMappings.rationale: Protected runtime composition and operational hook wiring.

componentMappings.title: API plugins
componentMappings.rationale: Environment, logging, observability and other host-level plugin concerns.

componentMappings.title: API runtime services
componentMappings.rationale: Long-lived runtime concerns such as reconciliation health and startup/shutdown coordination.

componentMappings.title: API database support
componentMappings.rationale: API-local database support code that is physically separate from @dvt/adapter-postgres.
